headline: Ransomware Strikes Hitachi Astemo's Dongguan Facility
body: Hitachi Astemo Automotive Powertrain Technologies (Dongguan) Ltd. recently fell victim to a ransomware attack that encrypted part of its local IT infrastructure. This incident led to the temporary closure of several production sites as the company worked to contain the breach. As a prominent supplier in the automotive sector, Hitachi Astemo plays a crucial role in the supply chain. The company is committed to strengthening its cybersecurity defenses to prevent similar incidents in the future.
